entries: Digestion: food travels mouth to intestines: food is chewed in the mouth, mixed in the stomach, and the good parts are taken out in the intestines.
slots.label: Digestion
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Breathing: air moves in and out of the lungs: air travels down the windpipe, the lungs fill and grow bigger, then shrink as air flows back out.
slots.label: Breathing
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Circulation: blood loops round and round: the heart pumps blood out to the body, and the same blood travels back to the heart to go round again.
slots.label: Circulation
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A common mistake: blood is not used up: the heart is a pump, and the returning blood proves that blood keeps looping instead of being used up.
slots.label: A common mistake
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The system that breaks down food: the mouth chews it, the stomach mixes it, and the intestines take out the good parts the body needs.
slots.label: Digestive system
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The system that moves air in and out of the body: air travels down the windpipe into the lungs and back out again.
slots.label: Breathing (respiratory) system
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The system that carries blood round the body in a loop: the heart pumps blood out to the body and the same blood returns to the heart.
slots.label: Circulatory system
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The pump in the circulatory system: it pushes blood out to the body and receives it back, round and round, without using it up.
slots.label: Heart
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The organs of breathing: they fill with air and grow bigger when we breathe in, then shrink as air flows back out.
slots.label: Lungs
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
